Booking questions

Questions about out of office
What happens to bookings, who gets told, and when it ends.
Ask a question
What happens to my bookings when I go out of office?
New bookings on those days are blocked, or sent to the teammate you picked. Bookings you already have stay as they are; if they fall in your time off, your organization's admins get an email listing them so someone can reassign them.
Can I redirect bookings to a colleague while I'm away?
Yes, on a Teams plan. Turn on "Provide a link to a team member when OOO" and pick who. Your booking page then names them and shows a button to book them instead.
What if I forget to turn it off when I'm back?
You can't forget. Every entry has an end date, and the day after it your booking page opens again on its own.
Can people see why I'm away?
Only if you want them to. Your note stays private until you tick "Show note on public booking page"; the reason shows as its emoji either way.
Can an admin set out of office for someone else?
Yes. Team admins and owners add entries for members from the Team OOO tab, for example when someone is off sick.
